description:
The Role:

We're currently 10 full-time engineers on the team. Engineers here own full features from design handoff through production, work across the stack, and are expected to move fast. There's no defined specialization – you'll touch whatever needs to get done.

The product has three main technical areas:

 - App & social layer – groups, feeds, in-game chat, onboarding, user profiles

 - Game engine – building real-time games

 - Payments & compliance – deposits, withdrawals, KYC, geo-fencing, AML, etc.

Location: New York, NY (in-office).

You will:

 - Own full features from design handoff through production

 - Work across the stack and move fast, touching whatever needs to get done

 - Build across the product's three main technical areas: the app and social layer, the game engine, and payments and compliance

Qualifications:

 - BS or equivalent in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field – recent graduates (2023–2026) encouraged.

 - Some hands-on development experience: internships, full-time roles, and/or personal projects.

 - Attention to detail, particularly on frontend/UI implementation and overall user flows.

 - Willingness to work in-office full-time in New York (must be able to relocate by October 2026).

 - Strong work ethic and comfort operating in an environment with ambiguity.

TypeScript, Java, React Native, SQL, and AWS are relevant to what we build. Poker knowledge is not required.

Perks & Benefits:

 - Free Equinox membership for the in-person team

 - Dinner provided in the office every night

 - Up to $60/day for other meals when in the office (in-person team)

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of premiums covered by the company, starting on your first day

 - Weekly dry cleaning and laundry service for the in-person team

 - Company computer

Pure is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
